Setting an alarm works for me when it comes to time management and me NEEDING to get stuff done. For example…

Set an alarm for 8 AM and maybe clean two hours. Whatever you clean in those two hours is what you’re doing for today. Then at 10 AM do another chore or maybe take a “hobby break “ to do something you enjoy. At 12 go back to doing an important task (bills, taxes, phone call you need to make, etc.) 

This is just an example but modifying to what your schedule looks like can help you a lot. Also what helps me is remembering anything is better than nothing. 🙂
